verses.text: Of Solomon. Endow the king with Your justice, O God, and the son of the king with Your righteousness.

segments.text: Of Solomon. Endow the king with Your justice, O God, and the son of the king with Your righteousness.

verses.text: May he judge Your people with righteousness and Your afflicted with justice.

segments.text: May he judge Your people with righteousness and Your afflicted with justice.

verses.text: May the mountains bring peace to the people, and the hills bring righteousness.

segments.text: May the mountains bring peace to the people, and the hills bring righteousness.

verses.text: May he vindicate the afflicted among the people; may he save the children of the needy and crush the oppressor.

segments.text: May he vindicate the afflicted among the people; may he save the children of the needy and crush the oppressor.

verses.text: May they fear him as long as the sun shines, as long as the moon remains, through all generations.

segments.text: May they fear him as long as the sun shines, as long as the moon remains, through all generations.

verses.text: May he be like rain that falls on freshly cut grass, like spring showers that water the earth.

segments.text: May he be like rain that falls on freshly cut grass, like spring showers that water the earth.

verses.text: May the righteous flourish in his days and prosperity abound until the moon is no more.

segments.text: May the righteous flourish in his days and prosperity abound until the moon is no more.

verses.text: May he rule from sea to sea, and from the Euphrates to the ends of the earth.

segments.text: May he rule from sea to sea, and from the Euphrates to the ends of the earth.

verses.text: May the nomads bow before him, and his enemies lick the dust.

segments.text: May the nomads bow before him, and his enemies lick the dust.

verses.text: May the kings of Tarshish and distant shores bring tribute; may the kings of Sheba and Seba offer gifts.

segments.text: May the kings of Tarshish and distant shores bring tribute; may the kings of Sheba and Seba offer gifts.

verses.text: May all kings bow down to him and all nations serve him.

segments.text: May all kings bow down to him and all nations serve him.

verses.text: For he will deliver the needy who cry out and the afflicted who have no helper.

segments.text: For he will deliver the needy who cry out and the afflicted who have no helper.

verses.text: He will take pity on the poor and needy and save the lives of the oppressed.

segments.text: He will take pity on the poor and needy and save the lives of the oppressed.

verses.text: He will redeem them from oppression and violence, for their blood is precious in his sight.

segments.text: He will redeem them from oppression and violence, for their blood is precious in his sight.

verses.text: Long may he live! May gold from Sheba be given him. May people ever pray for him; may they bless him all day long.

segments.text: Long may he live! May gold from Sheba be given him. May people ever pray for him; may they bless him all day long.

verses.text: May there be an abundance of grain in the land; may it sway atop the hills. May its fruit trees flourish like the forests of Lebanon, the people of its cities like the grass of the field.

segments.text: May there be an abundance of grain in the land; may it sway atop the hills. May its fruit trees flourish like the forests of Lebanon, the people of its cities like the grass of the field.

verses.text: May his name endure forever; may his name continue as long as the sun shines. In him may all nations be blessed; may they call him blessed.

segments.text: May his name endure forever; may his name continue as long as the sun shines. In him may all nations be blessed; may they call him blessed.

verses.text: Blessed be the LORD God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds.

segments.text: Blessed be the LORD God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds.

verses.text: And blessed be His glorious name forever; may all the earth be filled with His glory. Amen and amen.

segments.text: And blessed be His glorious name forever; may all the earth be filled with His glory. Amen and amen.

verses.text: Thus conclude the prayers of David son of Jesse.
